ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast macro-level distribution; approximately 45% high-intensity (white) pixels localized distally and 55% low-intensity (black) pixels localized proximally.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Two primary high-intensity (white) contiguous blobs located on the distal thirds of the left and right lobes; a centralized low-intensity (black) region encompassing the median notch and radiating toward the mid-lobe regions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with an estimated interior angle of approximately 85-90 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular trailing edge with high-frequency serrations; distal tips exhibit extreme high-amplitude (5-12 pixel) irregular protrusions, while medial edges show moderate amplitude variations.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Generally convex mathematical curve fitted to the posterior margins of both lobes, terminating in ragged distal boundaries.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense, dark, textured pixel clusters (barnacle colonies) concentrated on the extreme distal tips of both lobes, creating a non-linear, ragged pixel profile.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, low-intensity unaligned linear streaks (rake marks) are visible within the high-intensity white distal region of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle encrustation and bio-fouling on both distal lobe tips, significantly altering the natural geometric contour of the trailing edge.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly distinctive 'shredded' appearance of the lobe tips due to heavy parasitic load, contrasting with the relatively smooth pigmentation transition.
